_how_to: Add bills to the list below. Copy the example (everything between its { and }) into the brackets after "bills", and put a comma between bills. Status is one of: pending, passed, signed, vetoed, failed, withdrawn. Dates look like 2026-10-24. Leave a field as null if it doesn't apply. In "text", \n starts a new paragraph. A bill added in Discord with /bill-add that has the same number replaces the one here.
